search.limitations: Compared VPE 1.6 real Def sources and CCTO owner XML/design; non-VE Expandable Plants source metadata and feature descriptions and public Night Crops description, not full loaded code. No exhaustive global Workshop scan, live VPE 1.7 check, combined mod list or numeric species field experiments. This does not claim compatibility with every third-party cold patch.

decision.rationale: Vanilla Plants Expanded supplies the exact 14 plants but no inspected CCTO per-species mapping, and the existing CCTO framework already solves the cold-death/dormancy behavior. An opt-in VPE-only XML consumer fills this narrow missing data without modifying core CCTO, rewriting plant classes or requiring another runtime framework; MO remains integrated.
